paths.contract: thread/queue/add schedules input when the owned receiver becomes idle. A busy receiver processes a later turn. Exact-name lookup rejects ambiguity and uses cwd=None; worktree scope therefore needs the owned native thread binding. Repeating the CLI call creates another client message ID, rather than proving deduplication.

ListAgents/SendMessage deliver to native Claude peers between tool calls and start a turn for idle recipients when the session and role expose these tools. Research-role tool restrictions must be checked independently of lead-session capability.
paths.existing_native_observation: cooperation.json retains actual native SendMessage returned success and the designated owner's response. Neither proves automatic Codex-to-Claude bridging.

paths.contract: The Codex PostToolUse hook checks an unread count without message bodies and injects a fetch_inbox reminder. The reminder can recur after 120 seconds until consumed. Tool-boundary polling does not activate an idle native turn or establish one model submission.
paths.adoption: Conditional comparison; no install or capture/receiver acceptance.

paths.contract: The tagged setup adds HTTP MCP to Codex and hooks to Claude. Project-scoped adjective+noun mailbox identities and self-asserted program/model metadata do not bind native threads. Persisted, signal-file-written and acknowledged delivery receipts do not mean the model submitted a turn.
paths.native_acceptance_status: Not run. Source-supported mailbox/crash-recovery suites do not test selected-client model parity. test_idempotency.sh concerns installer idempotency; message idempotency instead needs the explicit messaging key.
paths.adoption: Conditional comparison; distinct maintained Python and Rust repositories, no redirect-based replacement claim.

paths.contract: The adapter invokes Codex SDK exec, defaults web search off and advertises low/medium/high reasoning effort. It does not establish the selected shared-daemon Sol/max or Sol/ultra receiver contract. Relay's generic app_server runtime dispatches OpenCode.
paths.adoption: Automatic PTY submission remains held by existing-host-gates.json; transport and restart receipts do not close it.

paths.contract: The proposed Codex injector calls the native queue and adds a persisted delivery barrier. Its Claude side reads peer-token session records. This is unmerged comparison evidence, not a supported installed bridge or the native Claude SendMessage contract.

failed_access: A guessed Rust E2E runner URL returned 404; the authoritative native runner and README testing entry were subsequently located.
next_native_comparison: On isolated owned receivers, separate Python tool-boundary reminder injection, mailbox fetch and model acknowledgement in idle/busy states; qualify Rust's unchanged persistence/restart suites separately. Preserve native model, effort, tools, thread binding, retry semantics and scope.

closure.reopen_on: A maintained native queue adapter or upstream merged integration with unchanged native acceptance, receiver identity, deduplication and lifecycle evidence.

limitations: Read-only source follow-up. No bridge was written, no software installed, no credentials/inbox/private conversations read and no provider trial performed.
